maddeler.e:
تحتازوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَازُوا (taḥtāzū) /taħ.taː.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# تُحْتَازُوا (tuḥtāzū) /tuħ.taː.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
